Jamie L: on it, starting smoke checks :eyes:
Priya S: quick question — any DB migration in this release? want to confirm rollback steps.
Marco R: no DB migrations. rollback plan: revert to tag v3.5.9 and re-promote the previous commit. I'll hold the rollback button if needed.
Priya S: thanks — can you paste the ops commands i'll need if we have to revert?
Marco R: sure — rollback quick commands:
```
# promote previous tag
releasectl promote --env=prod --tag=v3.5.9
# force traffic back to previous replicaset
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=2
```
Marco R: also note: config flag `use_new_token_cache=false` is set for this release in prod; that'll avoid seqlen cache invalidation.
